scope: Offline source audit and pure timing mathematics, not native duration/casting acceptance

conclusions.scheduling: Linear fixed independent-lane model; preserve per-caster order, initial availability and effect-delivery delays.
conclusions.accounting: Compute reference age minus actual age per newly owned effect; do not subtract virtual age twice.
conclusions.extension: Exact JIT balance can require restoring time to a still-live new effect. Conservative no-extension policy is explicitly approximate.
conclusions.primary_risk: Attribution and engine-safe per-effect lifetime changes, not scheduling complexity.
conclusions.recommended_next: Observation-only timing/ownership ledger before any live expiry mutation.
conclusions.unsupported_scope: Dependent casts, item sharing/uses, periodic/delayed or irreversible effects, 5E wrappers and unverified variant delivery need separate acceptance.
